name: Mount Tabor

related_people.name: Barak
related_people.role: mustered ten thousand men on this mountain before routing Sisera

related_people.name: Deborah
related_people.role: sent Barak down from this mountain against Sisera's army

related_people.name: Sisera
related_people.role: his chariots were drawn to the Kishon below this mountain and destroyed

description: A prominent, isolated hill in the Jezreel Valley where Deborah directed Barak to gather Israel's forces before their victory over Sisera's chariot army (Judges 4:6, 12-16).
family_friendly_summary: Mount Tabor is a tall, rounded hill that stands alone in the Jezreel Valley. The judge Deborah told the commander Barak to gather Israel's army there before God gave them the victory over Sisera and his chariots.
